## Six Service Divisions

- [Websites & Software](https://www.unikorn360.com/services/websites-software): Custom websites, e-commerce stores, web applications, mobile apps, SaaS MVPs, and API integrations.
- [Security & Maintenance](https://www.unikorn360.com/services/security-maintenance): Application security reviews, AI code audits, API security, database reviews, server hardening, and maintenance.
- [Marketing & Creator Campaigns](https://www.unikorn360.com/services/marketing-creator-campaigns): Technical & local SEO, paid advertising, social media content, UGC video production, and creator campaigns.
- [AI, Automation & Business Systems](https://www.unikorn360.com/services/ai-automation-business-systems): AI chatbots, custom AI agents, workflow automation, CRM pipelines, WhatsApp Business systems, and executive dashboards.
- [Research & Business Strategy](https://www.unikorn360.com/services/research-business-strategy): Customer & competitor research, industry trends, business performance diagnostics, financial feasibility, and startup consulting.
- [Business Setup & Documentation](https://www.unikorn360.com/services/business-setup-documentation): Company registration, GST & Udyam, trademark filing coordination, government schemes, bank DPRs, and property documentation.

## Standalone Software Products

- [InvoicePro360](https://www.unikorn360.com/products/invoicepro360) ([Open App](https://invoicepro360.unikorn360.com/)): GST billing, quotations, inventory, and client invoicing application.
- [Deeds360](https://www.unikorn360.com/products/deeds360) ([Open App](https://deeds360.unikorn360.com/)): Bilingual English & Tamil property deed drafting system for document writers.
- [Property360](https://www.unikorn360.com/products/property360) ([Open App](https://property360.unikorn360.com/)): Property verification and legal case evaluation platform.
- [Advocate360](https://www.unikorn360.com/products/advocate360) ([Open App](https://advocate360.unikorn360.com/)): Legal chamber practice, court docket, and case brief management workspace.

## Disallowed Utility Routes

- `/admin`, `/admin/login` (administrative console, noindex)
- `/creators/apply`, `/creators/success` (registration flow, noindex)
- `/api/*` (backend endpoints)
